inspection.limits: Descriptive scores only. No forward labels, PnL, alpha, formal evaluation or proof that a revision is better. Sample SD uses n-1; windows use past observed rows, with no filling. Historical price jumps cannot identify corporate actions.

prose_proof.limits: Checks explicit count equations, the recognized window-subtraction grammar, unqualified every-observed-date claims and the recorded numeric signal-count claim of executability/tradability. Not a general semantic proof.
